info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Loyalty Points Tiers-v1-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Tiers API provides access to the various loyalty points tiers available for hotel programs. This API enables clients to retrieve detailed information about each tier, including benefits and requirements that customers can achieve. Typical consumers include travel agencies, loyalty program managers, and software developers integrating loyalty features into their applications. Leveraging this information allows businesses to enhance customer engagement and optimize their loyalty programs effectively.

get.summary: Retrieve the tier of points associated with the user.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current tier of points for a user, which may determine their privileges and rewards. Utilize this to understand where you stand in our loyalty program and explore available benefits.
